data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (From/To, date, passengers/cabin, Confirm, Show flights, Select fare) with the right parameters and order. It adds a one-way trip type step, a Continue click, and extra parameters (fare_type, stopover) that the true workflow doesn't have. It is concrete enough to automate, though the fare-selection step is somewhat vague.
